query: terminal-looking music app, sophisticated customizable computer interface, existing Maro layout and button positions preserved

references.title: Dashboard Terminal
references.creator: Rayyan Anugerah
references.application: Monospace headings, hairline panel dividers, small semantic status accents, restrained active-row treatment.
references.conflict: Its many telemetry panels and tiny text are not appropriate to copy into Maro. Preserve Maro's current panels and readable text sizes.

references.title: Terminal Style Dashboard Design
references.creator: Adrian Daniluk
references.application: Quiet charcoal rows, compact outlined controls, one restrained cyan/teal signal color.
references.conflict: Avoid its decorative edge glow as the default; existing playlist columns and button geometry stay fixed.

references.title: Satelite Panel - Terminal UI
references.creator: Hananda
references.application: Fine mint lines, aligned numeric metadata, calm technical framing inside existing panel bounds.
references.conflict: Do not add fake waveforms, graphs, labels, or additional panels merely to resemble an instrument console.

references.title: Trigger - HUD Elements Pack
references.creator: unknown; discovered through a Cyberdeck inspiration pin
references.application: Subtle corner brackets and thin technical frame details, drawn inside existing bounds.
references.conflict: Extensive HUD ornaments and crosshairs would compete with music artwork. This is secondary mood reference only.

references.title: TERMINAL 03
references.creator: Steven Bussey / VKTRKRFT / Toros Kose
references.application: Technical typographic rhythm and precise instrument readouts. The proposed warm amber palette is our interpretation, not the red palette of the reference.
references.conflict: Its red art direction and dense fictional data are unsuitable as default music-app styling.

references.title: rmpc - configurable terminal music client
references.creator: mierak and contributors
references.application: Music-specific evidence for semantic color themes, configurable text/columns and keyboard controls. Maro should retain its existing layout while offering cosmetic theme settings.
references.conflict: Do not adopt its different terminal layout or replace Maro's native player/provider.
references.status: Project and theme documentation inspected; reference image download returned HTTP 403 and was skipped.

references.title: Terminal - Magic UI
references.creator: Dillion Verma
references.license: MIT for component code; no component installed
references.application: Monospace roles and concise terminal chrome; a secondary reference for empty/loading treatments.
references.conflict: This is a React command-demo component. Do not transplant the dependency, typing animation, or fabricated command output into the native Swift app.

limits: Reference images are for inspiration; unknown licenses do not grant reuse as app assets.
